name: html-layout-table-root-avoids-preceding-float
description: A layout table lowered to core/group > core/columns keeps the table's block formatting context. A `width:100%` table after a full-width float is placed below the float at full width (source at 1440px: row x=0 y=88 w=800). The lowered group was a plain block that ignored the float, so its flex columns squeezed into the zero-width space beside it (row x=800 y=0 w=0, cells 30px wide, 1087px tall). The table root group now carries `blocks-engine-layout-table-root`, which the engine support CSS makes `display:flow-root`, so the row renders at x=0 y=88 w=800.

source_reference.notes: Reduction of issue #6799: Weebly multicolumn table following a floated full-width heading strip.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
